column1: REGISTRATION  OF  TITLE ACT, No.  21 OF  1998
Declaration  of  Determination  of  the  Commissioner  of  Title  Settlement  under  Section  14

B
Y virtue of the powers vested in me under Section 14 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998, I, the undersigned, hereby de-
clare my determination as set out in the Schedule appended hereto in regard to the  title to parcel of Land Nos. 7, 8 and 16 of Block 03,
contained in the Cadastral Map No. 830137, situated in the Village of Beliatta Town within the Grama Niladhari Division of No. 351 -
Beliatta Town in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Beliatta, in the District of Hambantota, in the Province of Southern, referred to
in Notice No. 83/0285 calling for claims to land parcels which was duly published in the Gazette No. 2090/31 of 27th September, 2018
in terms of Section 12 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998.
